figures.caption: Fig. 1: Eigenspectrum of the projector-output covariance, verifying Theorem 8. Negative-free alignment with prediction but no regularization (MSE, no regularization) collapses to a few dominant eigenvalues, consistent with the optimization collapse of Theorem 8. The contrastive variant (NT-Xent, no regularization) exhibits partial dimensional resistance, consistent with Remark 9, but does not reach the flat spectrum achieved by an explicit regularizer.

Table 1: Subset ablation isolating the contribution of each principle. Each row instantiates a strict subset of {Linv,Lpred,Lreg}, verifying Propositions 7, 10, and 11 and Theorem 8 and Remark 9. Our proposed model (row J) is the full contrastive configuration and serves as the reference. Row G (MSE + JEPA, no regularizer) collapses to low effective rank despite satisfying two principles, directly verifying Theorem 8; the low effective rank of row I despite explicit regularization is discussed in Section 6.

Table 2: Patch-level nearest-neighbour retrieval, verifying Proposition 10. Spatial recall@k measures the proportion of retrieved patches falling within the same spatial quadrant as the query. Removing prediction (row F) causes the largest drop, confirming the structural argument that without Lpred the encoder receives no spatial training signal.
Fig. 3: Per-patch gradient norm at the encoder output, verifying Theorem 15.

Fig. 4: Momentum-encoder redundancy, verifying Theorem 17. (a) The online and momentum parameter distance rises during early learning, then decays toward zero; the two converge to the same fixed point, consistent with the theorem’s convergence assumption. (b) Stop-gradient and momentum reach comparable accuracy; removing the stop-gradient produces a collapse trough, after which the regularizer drives full recovery to the same asymptote.
Fig. 5: Architecture and gradient flows for the three-principle decomposition.

Table 5: All major self-supervised methods recovered as special cases of Equation (3), as stated in Proposition 12. Projector hψ realizes Definition 4; predictor gϕ realizes Definition 5; Ω realizes Definition 6. † in the method name denotes a redundant implicit mechanism (momentum encoder or centering) alongside the explicit regularizer; † in the Reg column denotes implicit collapse prevention only; ‡ denotes prediction via a shared head rather than a dedicated predictor.
